name: Pacer Electronics
old_description: Welcome to Pacer Electronic Wire & Cable, Inc. We appreciate your visit to our Website and hope you will consider Pacer, to help you find what ever electronic wire or cable, you are looking for.
about:
Pacer Electronic Wire & Cable, Inc. operates from Chandler, Arizona, and has served businesses across the United States for more than three decades. Established as a regional supplier, the business grew into a national distributor without disclosing its founding year or ownership structure.

The company maintains an inventory of UL-listed and Mil-Spec wire, multi-conductor cable, coaxial cable, heat-shrink tubing, sleeving, and cable ties. Its value-added services include wire re-spooling, cutting, tinning, and crimping of Amp/Tyco and Molex terminals, as well as wire stripping and twisting.

Pacer serves a broad base of commercial and industrial clients, offering product lines such as plenum cables, military-specification wire, marine shipboard cables, coaxial dual-shield cables, instrumentation cables, and computer cables. The company works with manufacturers including Harbour Industries and RSCC Aero Defense to source its stock.

Founded on a service-first philosophy, Pacer emphasizes knowledgeable sales support and quick turnaround on value-added processing to meet specific customer requirements. The company states that service is its first priority, aiming to provide friendly, knowledgeable assistance for electronic wire needs.

name: Pacific Audio & Communications Maui
old_description: Since 1991, Pacific Audio & Communications has led the custom integration industry, building a reputation as one of the most trusted
about:
Pacific Audio & Communications was founded in 1991 in Kihei, Hawaii. The company began as a custom integration firm serving the Hawaiian islands, focusing on audio, video, and automation solutions for homes and businesses.

The firm designs, engineers, installs, and supports integrated technology systems that combine audio, video, lighting, shading, networking, and security. It has completed more than 1,000 installations across Hawaii, California, and Nevada, and holds Hawaii contractor licenses C-17128, C-24211, and ES-6089. The team also provides ongoing aftercare service and enterprise-grade network deployment.

Pacific Audio & Communications serves residential clients, commercial businesses, and hospitality venues, as well as federal and government agencies requiring network security. Trade partners include interior designers, architects, and custom builders. Notable projects include the Sky Honolulu, Westin Maui Social Space, Waialae Country Club, Del Dotto Winery, Iolani School, and several private residences.

The company emphasizes its HTA certification, which requires proven technical expertise, comprehensive background checks, and a record of stellar business performance. It differentiates itself through aftercare service, endorsements from manufacturers and design professionals, and a commitment to local craftsmanship and the aloha spirit.

name: Pacific Electric Inc
old_description: Founded in 1978 by four colleagues with a simple mission — “Do what you say you’re going to do” — Pacific Electric was established on a foundation of truth, integrity, and hard work.
about:
Pacific Electric Inc was founded in 1978 in Corona, California, by four colleagues who set out with a simple mission: “Do what you say you’re going to do.” The company began as a hands-on operation focused on customized interconnection solutions for utilities, helping to shape what became known as the tap industry. In 2020, new ownership took the helm while preserving the original values and expanded the product line to include medium‑voltage equipment, panelboards, and switchboards.

Today Pacific Electric designs, manufactures, and delivers low‑ and medium‑voltage power distribution equipment, including switchgear, switchboards, panelboards, bus bar assemblies, and NEMA 3R or stainless‑steel enclosure wraps. The shop offers field bus modifications, breaker and component retrofits, and custom steel wraps with options such as sloped roofs, filtered louvers, and climate‑control accessories. Stocked bus bar assemblies can ship the same day, and all switchgear carries UL listing with integrated metering, communications, and monitoring.

The company serves commercial construction, industrial and institutional facilities, photovoltaic and EV infrastructure, data centers, healthcare, and emerging AI‑focused projects. Customers range from electrical contractors and facility managers to utility operators who need reliable upgrades or expansions without full system replacement.

Pacific Electric differentiates itself through a culture built on integrity, safety, and customer focus. Its retrofit approach extends equipment life and reduces downtime, while same‑day shipping on standard bus bars accelerates project schedules. The firm emphasizes sustainable practices and collaborative problem‑solving to meet evolving electrification demands.

name: Pacific Furniture Manufacturing
old_description: Proudly Family-Owned and Handcrafted in Phoenix, AZ since 1958.
about:
Pacific Furniture Manufacturing, operating as Pacific Seasons, has been a family-owned business in Phoenix, Arizona since 1958. The company was founded on a commitment to handcrafted upholstered furniture made locally.

The company designs, fabricates, and upholsters custom furniture in its Phoenix factory, where a team of craftsmen—some with more than 25 years of tenure—build each piece from sustainably sourced raw materials. The process moves from design through fabrication to final upholstery, allowing for fully customized pieces as well as curated collections.

Pacific Seasons serves residential clients and interior designers, offering private showroom appointments in Scottsdale and factory visits for design professionals. The company emphasizes collaboration with designers looking for manufacturing partners to expand their portfolios.

The business distinguishes itself through its family ownership, domestic production, and a workforce with deep institutional knowledge. Leadership includes President Grace Hansen, COO Chris Hansen, and Plant Manager Brent Hansen, who collectively bring decades of experience in operations, supply chain, and high-volume manufacturing.

about:
Pacific Medical Healthcare, doing business as PacMed, operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, and describes itself as the state's only one-stop healthcare equipment and supplies provider. The company does not publish its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

PacMed's product catalog spans mobility equipment, powered mobility devices, electric beds, ventilators, respiratory supplies, orthotics and prosthetics, urological supplies, and wound dressings. In addition to retail and wholesale distribution, the company processes insurance assignments for Medicare and all local insurers, provides repair and maintenance services for medical equipment, and offers custom design and manufacturing of home modifications including bathroom remodeling, ramp installation, and lift systems.

The customer base includes home-care patients, insurance providers, and healthcare facilities throughout Hawaii. During periods of high demand, PacMed has supplied PPE container specials — such as hand sanitizer, sanitizing wipes, infrared thermometers, and vinyl gloves — directly to the community.

The company states that its combination of retail, insurance, and wholesale services, alongside in-house repair capabilities and custom home-modification fabrication, sets it apart in the local market.

name: Pacific Solar
old_description: Founded in the Central Valley, our family-owned company is dedicated to helping homeowners and businesses across California take advantage of solar energy systems.
about:
Pacific Solar was founded in 1982 in the Central Valley city of Clovis, California. The family-owned business began as a local solar contractor serving homeowners and businesses across the region.

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural properties. Its in-house team of certified professionals handles system design, panel installation, battery storage integration, EV charger installation, thermal drone scanning for system diagnostics, and ground-mount construction, along with ongoing maintenance, repairs, and assistance with permission-to-operate requests, interconnection, and incentive paperwork.

Pacific Solar serves customers throughout Central California, including Fresno, Clovis, Sacramento, San Jose, Bakersfield, Stockton, and the Central Coast. Its client base spans homeowners, businesses, and farms seeking to reduce electricity costs and gain energy independence through rooftop, ground-mounted, and battery-backed solar arrays.

The company differentiates itself with a savings guarantee—promising to cover the difference, add panels, or refund money if a system doesn’t lower utility bills by year-end—and a 25-year workmanship guarantee covering installation-related issues. Operating entirely in-house, the family-owned firm emphasizes local accountability and certified expertise on every project.

Pack-O-Mach Corporation is based in Andover, Minnesota. The company traces its roots to 1961 when it began representing manufacturers of bakery and foodservice equipment. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm operates as a distributor and service provider for commercial baking equipment. It supplies ovens, proofers, slicers, depositing and sheeting systems, mixers, donut equipment, packaging and display units from partners such as Revent, Empire and Plas-Ties. Beyond equipment sales, Pack-O-Mach offers installation and pre-site planning, warranty service, parts inventory management, and buys and sells used equipment. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers range from small independent bakeries to large wholesale operations across the bakery and foodservice sectors. The company focuses on the North American market, though specific geographic reach is not detailed.

Pack-O-Mach emphasizes its selective manufacturer partnerships as a differentiator, stating that working only with brands allows it to deliver quality and value. The business was founded on the principle of matching bakeries with productive equipment to improve their bottom line.

name: PackNWood
old_description: PacknWood specializes in high-quality eco-friendly restaurant supplies. Our single use macaron boxes are made of wood, cardboard, paper, and eco-friendly plastic that are better for the environment than traditional materials. They also come in a variety of shapes, including windowed lunchboxes, windowed boxes that hold seven macarons, long pastry boxes, cylindrical wooden boxes, and colored boxes made from corrugated cardboard. All our boxes are designed to have a distinct look that fits well with any restaurant service design. The colorful choices and elegant finish of the different materials make them perfect for takeout, delivery, and catering orders.
about:
PackNWood operates from its Midtown Manhattan office in New York City. It is the American and British brand of First Pack, a family-owned French company that has manufactured innovative food service products for over 35 years. The brand was created to link an international supply network spanning Asia, Africa, Europe, and North America to design sustainable tableware for culinary presentation.

PackNWood curates a broad range of disposable and reusable food packaging—including wooden boxes, bamboo cutlery, sugarcane containers, paper straws, and sealing molds—sourced from a global network of manufacturers. The company provides custom branding services, guiding clients from artwork through production on items such as cups, bags, boxes, trays, and labels. Its New York showroom displays the product line for professional buyers.

The brand serves restaurants, caterers, bakeries, and foodservice operators needing takeout, delivery, and catering packaging. Its products appear in patisseries for macaron presentation, in catering trays for events, and in takeout containers for quick-service restaurants. The customizable solutions target businesses looking to extend their brand identity through packaging.

PackNWood emphasizes eco-responsible design, selecting materials such as wood, paper, bamboo, and recyclable plastics for their environmental impact as well as performance.
